name: Premier Motor Service student fares
summary: Discounted coach fares on Premier's east-coast express services for concession card holders, including students.
who: Concession card holders, including students, pensioners and seniors.
catches: The page does not state the discount or which student ID is accepted. Call 13 34 10 to confirm.
A $2.50 Regional Excursion Daily (RED) fare may apply between Nowra and Eden or Lismore and Tweed Heads, booked by phone.

evidence.quote: We have a range of discounted fares available for children as well as concession card holders
